zombie.about.title: What is ZombieTrend AI?
zombie.about.one: ZombieTrend AI is an online generator for the AI zombie trend, the short film format also known as the Zombie Love Story or the AI zombie hug. It took over TikTok in late September 2026 and reached Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts within days. Zombie trends come and go, but this one stuck because it is a love story, not a horror clip. In every version, someone you love has turned into a zombie, you cannot pull the trigger, and the clip cuts to a warm memory of the two of you.
zombie.about.two: Most people make these clips by following a tutorial: one prompt for the zombie scene, another for the flashback, then stitching both together in CapCut, Dreamina or PixVerse. ZombieTrend AI replaces that whole workflow. You upload two photos, and it builds the zombie scene with GPT Image 2 and films the full four-beat story in one continuous Seedance 2.0 clip, sound included.
zombie.about.three: Because the second photo also drives the flashback, the person who turned looks like themselves twice: grey and clouded in the dark, then healthy and smiling in the sun. That contrast is why the trend makes people cry in the comments, and it is the part ZombieTrend AI is tuned to get right.
zombie.about.four: ZombieTrend AI runs in any browser on phone or desktop. There is no app to install and no template to hunt for, and every clip comes out vertical, ready to post.

zombie.how.one.text: First the one holding on, then the one who turned. Front-facing, good light, whole head in frame. The second photo becomes the zombie and their healthy self in the flashback.
zombie.how.two.title: Pick the memory
zombie.how.two.text: Choose where the story ends: a sunny picnic, a sunset beach, your wedding. Add one detail only you two would know, like an anniversary or a favourite scarf.

zombie.how.three.text: See the zombie scene free, no sign-up. Happy with it? Pick 8, 12 or 15 seconds and we film the story with sound. Twelve seconds fits all four beats.

zombie.prompt.title: The zombie AI trend prompt
zombie.prompt.one: Prefer to try it in Dreamina, Kling or Veo? This is the four-beat structure ZombieTrend AI uses. Attach the survivor photo first and the one who turned second, then paste it as the video prompt.
zombie.prompt.two: Keep the "no blood, no gore" line. Most video models refuse violent scenes, and the trend works because it is tender, not scary. Change only the flashback line to make it yours.
zombie.prompt.copy_text:
Emotional 12-second post-apocalyptic short film, vertical 9:16, cinematic and realistic. The person in image 1 is the survivor; the person in image 2 has turned into a zombie with pale grey skin and clouded white eyes but is still clearly recognizable.
Beat 1: close-up of the survivor raising a pistol with shaking hands, tears on their face, on a dark ruined street with smoke.
Beat 2: the zombie staggers closer, then stops and tilts its head, recognizing them.
Beat 3: the survivor lowers the gun; the zombie gently hugs them instead of biting, and the survivor hugs back, crying.
Beat 4: hard cut to a warm sunny flashback of the same two, both healthy and human, laughing together on a picnic blanket in a green park. Golden light, film grain, slow motion.
Keep both faces consistent. No blood, no gore, no text. Soft emotional piano score, no dialogue.
zombie.guide.title: Three checks before you spend credits
zombie.guide.photos.title: Clear faces
zombie.guide.photos.text: Sharp, front-facing photos in even light. Skip sunglasses, heavy filters and group shots. For pets, shoot at eye level.
zombie.guide.motion.title: Right order
zombie.guide.motion.text: Photo one is always the survivor. Photo two turns, then appears healthy in the flashback.
zombie.guide.review.title: Watch before posting
zombie.guide.review.text: Check both faces, the hug and the flashback. If a face drifts, try a clearer photo or a shorter length.

zombie.faq.title: ZombieTrend AI FAQ
zombie.faq.zero.question: Is ZombieTrend AI free?
zombie.faq.zero.answer: The scene preview is free once a day, with no sign-up. The full video with sound uses credits: an 8-second video starts at $5.90, with no subscription.
zombie.faq.one.question: How do I make the AI zombie trend video of us?
zombie.faq.one.answer: Upload a photo of the survivor and a photo of the one who turned, pick the memory and length, and press the button. You see the scene in under a minute and the full video in about 3-5 minutes.
zombie.faq.two.question: What happens to my photos?
zombie.faq.two.answer: When you press the button, your photos are resized in your browser and sent to our AI provider (fal.ai) to create the scene and the video. Nothing is uploaded before that. Only use photos you have permission to use.
zombie.faq.three.question: Can my dog or cat be the zombie?
zombie.faq.three.answer: Yes. Pets are one of the most popular versions. Put the pet photo second and use a sharp, front-facing shot with both eyes visible.
zombie.faq.four.question: Why does a face look different in my result?
zombie.faq.four.answer: Video models drift when a photo is blurry, side-on or heavily filtered. Use a clear front-facing photo, check the order and try a shorter length. Failed runs are refunded automatically.
zombie.faq.five.question: Can I make it scarier?
zombie.faq.five.answer: Add mood details in the optional note, like a rainy night or a hospital corridor. We keep it non-graphic, which is also what keeps the clip shareable on TikTok and Instagram.
zombie.faq.six.question: How much does each length cost?
zombie.faq.six.answer: The exact credits for 8, 12 and 15 seconds are shown on the button and in the pricing section. Credits never expire while your account is open, and failed generations go back to your balance.
zombie.faq.seven.question: Do I need CapCut, Dreamina or PixVerse?
zombie.faq.seven.answer: No. ZombieTrend AI generates the zombie scene, the hug and the flashback as one clip in your browser. You can still add a trending sound in TikTok or CapCut afterwards.
zombie.faq.eight.question: Can I post the video on TikTok, Reels and Shorts?
zombie.faq.eight.answer: Yes. Every ZombieTrend AI video is a vertical 9:16 MP4 with sound and no watermark. Label it as AI-generated where the platform asks, and only post people who agreed to be in it.
